newsitem.title: USA: Pallet Recycling files for 2.75 mln share IPO.
newsitem.headline: Pallet Recycling files for 2.75 mln share IPO.

text.p: Pallet Recycling Associates of North America Inc said Thursday it planned to sell up to 2.75 million common shares in its initial public offering.
The Roseville, Minn., company, in an amended U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filing said the shares were expected to be priced between $4 and $6 per share.
The offering will be made through John Kinnard and Co Inc, the company said. The underwriter will be offered an over-allotment option on 412,500 common shares.
Pallet said it would have 6,264,716 shares outstanding after the offer.
The company applied to be traded on the Nasdaq small-cap market under the symbol "PRNA.O" and on the Boston Stock Exchange under the symbol "PRN.B"
